body.name: compact primitive moment-feasibility class
body.construction: \(\overline\Theta_N(s_N)=\operatorname{cl}\{\vartheta=(p,\Gamma,(m_c,H_c,\sigma_c)_{c=1}^C):p\in\Delta^{C-1},\ \min_cp_c\ge p_{\star},\ \Gamma^{\prime}\Gamma=I_2,\ v_{\star}I_2\preceq H_c\preceq v^{\star}I_2,\ m\in\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H),\ 0\le\sigma_c\le B,\ \lambda_2(\Gamma_{S_c}H_c\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime})\ge g_{\star}\text{ for every }c\in[C],\ s_N\le s(\vartheta)\le2s_N\}\) for every \(N\in\mathbb N\).
